semantic_fragments.content: The Infrared Forehead Thermometer is intended for the intermittent measurement of body temperature from the forehead skin surface on people of all ages. It can be used by consumers in the household environment and by health care providers.

The risk management activity including the risk management plan was began at the time the project is approved. This risk management review is to assess the harm and make the risk analysis, evaluation, and proposed the risk control plan.

Criteria for risk evaluation: Please find the document Risk Management Plan (PT9L-FXJH01 V1.0) for the risk acceptance criteria. Severity scale: 1 negligible; 2 minor; 3 Serious; 4 Critical; 5 Catastrophic. Probability scale: 6 Frequent; 5 Probable; 4 Occasional; 3 Remote; 2 Improbable; 1 Few.

Document structure includes: Signification of Abbreviations, Overview (product introduction, risk management plan implementation, risk management group), Criteria for risk evaluation, Identify medical device characteristics that could impact on safety and intended use (bibliography, questions from ISO/TR 24971:2020 Annex A, questions from IEC 60601-1:2005+AMD1:2012+AMD2:2020 Edition 3.2, additional questions from IEC 60601-1-2:2014+A1:2020 edition 4.1), Risk analysis/risk evaluation and PRM, Risk Management Conclusion, Signature of the risk management group.

基于ISO/TR 24971:2020附录A的设备特性问卷分析结果摘要：

【A.2.1 预期用途】PT9L用于体温测量，非生命支持类设备。信息安全失效可能影响数据机密性、导致性能下降或失去可用性；未经授权的访问、活动或数据丢失可能影响设备安全。禁忌：测量部位存在局部病变（如炎症、创伤、术后）者不推荐使用。涉及危害源：电能、机械能、生物制剂、化学制剂、免疫制剂、数据、功能性。

【A.2.2 植入】否，非植入式设备。

【A.2.3 患者接触】是，产品与皮肤短时间接触。涉及危害源：化学制剂、免疫制剂。

【A.2.4 材料/组件】不与其他材料或体液接触；无动物源性材料；相关安全特性已知。

【A.2.5 能量传输】是，从患者获取红外线。传输类型：电磁波；控制参数：测量时间；能量水平不高于同类设备。涉及危害源：电磁波。

【A.2.6 物质传输】否。

【A.2.7 生物材料处理】否。

【A.2.8 无菌供应】否，设备为非无菌状态。

【A.2.9 清洁/消毒】是，需对探头进行常规清洁和消毒。涉及危害源：生物制剂、化学制剂、免疫制剂。

【A.2.10 修改患者环境】否。

【A.2.11 测量功能】是，测量体温。涉及危害源：数据、功能性。

【A.2.12 解释性功能】否，不执行分析处理。

【A.2.13 与其他设备联用】否。

【A.2.14 非预期能量/物质输出】是，存在非预期能量输出，包括非电离辐射、电能和热能；无非预期物质输出。涉及危害源：辐射能、电能、热能。

【A.2.15 环境敏感性】是，对温度、湿度、电磁干扰、大气压、振动、灰尘、光线和昆虫等环境因素敏感。涉及危害源：辐射能、功能性。

【A.2.16 对环境的影响】是，通过电磁辐射、电池使用和报废处置影响环境。涉及危害源：辐射能、化学制剂。

【A.2.17 耗材/附件】是，需要电池。涉及危害源：功能性、热能。

【A.2.18 维护/校准】是，需要由经培训的专业人员进行校准。涉及危害源：功能性。

A.2.19: 医疗器械包含软件。对于非联网型号，无需安装和验证。但对于应用App连接型号或蓝牙型号，需要软件安装和验证。
A.2.20: 仅具有蓝牙功能的型号允许访问信息。
A.2.21: 医疗器械存储体温测量数据。
A.2.22: 仅有使用寿命限制，无特定货架寿命。
A.2.23: 存在延迟或长期使用影响——标签磨损。
A.2.24: 不受机械力影响。
A.2.25: 器械使用寿命由元器件老化决定。
A.2.26: 器械不用于单次使用。
A.2.27: 需要妥善处置器械本身及其存储的数据。
A.2.28: 使用不需要特殊培训或技能。
A.2.29: 安全使用信息通过制造商提供的用户手册直接提供给最终用户，不需要额外培训。
A.2.30: 未建立或引入新的制造工艺。
A.2.31: 器械的成功应用不依赖于用户界面的可用性。
A.2.31.1: 用户界面设计特征不会导致使用错误。
A.2.31.2: 不在可能因分心导致使用错误的紧急医疗环境中使用。
A.2.31.3: 无连接部件或附件。
A.2.31.4: 无控制界面。
A.2.31.5: 医疗器械显示测量值和警告信息。
A.2.31.6: 不通过菜单控制，仅有简单按钮或直接控制操作。
A.2.31.7: 成功使用不依赖用户的知识、技能和能力。
A.2.31.8: 不会被有特殊需求的人员使用。
A.2.31.9: 用户界面不允许访问受限操作模式，无法启动未授权操作。
A.2.32: 医疗器械包含技术报警系统。
A.2.33: 潜在误用方式包括：用于非预期人群、不当环境、不当维护或连接故障。
A.2.34: 为便携式设备。
A.2.35: 器械使用依赖基本性能。
A.2.36: 开始测量后，器械自动执行测量过程，遇到问题时发出虚假警告。
A.2.37: 器械输出不用作确定临床措施的输入。

7.2.2 Identification: The foreseeable misuse of marking of label was considered. 7.2.13 Physiological effects (safety signs and warning): The EUT is not producing physiological effects. 7.2.17 Protective packaging: Have special handling instruction for transportation or storage needed. Premature removal of packaging does not pose an unacceptable risk to the product or accessories. 7.3.3 Batteries: Lithium battery has warning labels. Dry battery has no warning labels. 7.4.2 Control devices: The switches indicated by symbols. 7.5 Safety signs: Warning, Prohibition, Mandatory action are used.

7.9.2.4 Electrical power source - Whether the leakage of the battery would lead to an unacceptable risk? Does loss of power pose an unacceptable risk? Yes, include: Low battery; Battery leakage - the risk of battery leakage is acceptable, the instruction manual should include a 'warning to remove the battery if it is not possible to use the ME device for a certain period of time'. Loss of power can lead to unacceptable risk, design to allow for rapid release of pressure when loss of power.

8.1: No parts of the medical device are in separate enclosures connected by power carrying conductors. No components of the medical device can move unexpectedly during its expected service life. 8.5.2.2: No type-B applied part device. 8.5.2.3: No patient leads. 8.6.3: No moving parts that are protectively earthed. 8.8.4.1: Reinforced insulation case requires specific test protocols for verifying resistance to heat during expected service life. 8.10.1: Inner lead component is securely mounted for the expected service lifetime.

9.2.1: Moving parts cannot be touched - moving parts of the medical equipment need to be exposed for the medical equipment to perform its intended function. 9.2.2.1: No trapping zone that presents a mechanical hazard. 9.2.2.4: No guards or other risk control measures for trapping zone. 9.2.2.6: No parts used to position the patient or parts of the medical device itself. 9.2.3.1 Unintended movement: Controls are positioned, recessed, or protected by other means so that they cannot be accidentally actuated - No unacceptable risk is created. 9.2.4: No emergency stopping devices. 9.2.5: No means for releasing the patient quickly and safely in the event of breakdown or power failure.

9.5.1: No expelled parts - no protection against expelled parts needed. 9.6.1: Noise and vibration levels generated by the medical device shall not exceed ≦80dBA. 9.6.2.2: No source of infrasound and ultrasound. 9.7.2: No pneumatic or hydraulic parts. 9.7.7: No pressure relief devices. 9.8.1: No parts designed to support loads or to provide actuating forces. 9.8.2: No support systems requiring structural integrity demonstration beyond IEC/EN 60601-1. 9.8.3.1: No parts used for support or immobilization of the patient. 9.8.5: No primary support means requiring mechanical protective device.

10.1.2: No parts produce diagnostic or therapeutic X-radiation. 10.2: No parts produce alpha, beta, gamma, neutron or other particle radiation. 10.3: No parts produce microwave radiation. 10.5: No parts produce visible electromagnetic radiation. 10.6: Infrared probe produces infrared radiation. 10.7: No parts produce ultraviolet radiation.

IEC 60601-1-2:2014+A1:2020 edition 4.1 补充问题解答（片段6/9）：
- 非ME设备：ME系统中无非ME设备。
- 配置测试：不同系列产品分别测试；同系列产品（电路相似、功能相似）选取能覆盖综合电路和功能的产品进行测试。
- 排除环境：不能在活跃HF外科设备附近及MRI系统RF屏蔽室附近使用，该区域EM干扰强度高。
- 免疫测试通过/失败准则（基本安全）：可接触部件包括应用部分的爬电距离和空气间隙、介电强度、泄漏电流及患者辅助电流测量。
- 工作模式：发射测试时EUT配置为最高可能发射水平；免疫测试时EUT配置为对被测现象具有最高可能敏感性，测试条件参照使用说明书。
- 预期使用环境：专业医疗机构环境和家庭医疗保健环境，不会改变标准中规定的合理可预见EM干扰水平；电磁免疫测试按用户手册定义的体温计进行。
- 端口（ENCLOSURE PORT、交流/直流输入端口、PATIENT coupling PORT、SIP/SOP PORT）：设备对特定调制频率或频率范围不敏感，按表格所列频率测试。
- RF无线通信设备近场免疫：无额外频率和通信，参见IFU，按用户手册定义的体温计进行电磁免疫测试。
- 9 kHz至13.56 MHz频率范围内磁场免疫：本产品无对磁场敏感的元件或电路。

In section 4.2 Biological and chemical hazards, the following are N/A: Bacteria, Viruses, Other agents, Exposure of airway/tissues/environment/property to foreign materials, Degradation products/medical gas/Anesthesia products, Pyrogenicity.

Risk level evaluation uses two parameters: P (Probability) and S (Severity), rated numerically. Risk control measures are categorized into: Design control (e.g., EMC circuit design, thermal design, mechanical design, component selection, biocompatibility evaluation) and Marking warning (e.g., operation guide instructions). The table covers hazard categories 4.1 Energy hazards, 4.2 Biological and chemical hazards, and references 4.3 Operational hazards (content in next fragment).

Several hazard categories in the risk analysis table are marked as N/A (not applicable), including: Construction of connectors, reproducibility, Incorrect or inappropriate output or functionality, Interruption of the power supply, and Strangling or asphyxia. This indicates these hazard categories were evaluated and determined to present no relevant risk for this device.

Section 4.4 Information hazards covers risks arising from accompanying documents and external markings, including: hard-to-understand instructions, marking abrasion or poor adhesion, inadequate disclosure of limitations, and inadequate specification of intended use. All information hazards are addressed either through usability design controls or marking/warning in the operation guide.

Design control for environment condition risk R30 explicitly references compliance with ISO 80601-2-56:2017/Amd1:2018 requirements for environment conditions, indicating this standard is a normative reference for device environmental performance.

For each unacceptable Risk, we have considered risk control measures according to the principle of section3.3 'Risk Acceptance Criteria' in RMP. For each acceptable risk, we have further implemented risk control measures. So I think we have reduced the risk AFAP.
